p1.title: Standard Brain authorization accepts substitutions
p1.narrative: The validator can accept a forged but legal alternative instead of recomputing and authorizing the exact deterministic proposal selected by Standard Brain.

p1.title: Accepted Model Brain fails at scheduler boundary
p1.narrative: The benchmark exercises the gateway, but an accepted Model Brain proposal throws when it reaches the actual civilization scheduler decision boundary.

p1.title: Primary failure provenance is overwritten by fallback
p1.narrative: The accepted fallback record cannot separately preserve the failed model attempt and its immutable provenance, leaving the operational decision history incomplete.

p1.title: Model benchmark lacks manifest-bound artifact identity
p1.narrative: The local model benchmark is not cryptographically bound to its ExperimentManifest and does not attest the relationship between the recorded model tag and immutable blob.
